Fantasy Life.name: Fantasy Life
Fantasy Life.summary: The international release of Fantasy Life, released in 2014.

Gyakuten Saiban 4.name: Apollo Justice: Ace Attorney
Gyakuten Saiban 4.summary:
Apollo Justice: Ace Attorney, released in Japan as Gyakuten Saiban 4, is the fourth video game in the Ace Attorney series.
Apollo Justice is the first game in the series that does not feature Phoenix Wright as the main protagonist, though it is not the first time a different attorney has been playable. The game is set in the year 2026, which is seven years after Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney Trials and Tribulations. Phoenix Wright has been stripped of his attorney's badge, and Apollo Justice, an up-and-coming attorney, becomes his apprentice.

LBX - Little Battlers eXperience.name: LBX: Little Battlers eXperience
LBX - Little Battlers eXperience.summary: Play as Van Yamano, a young boy who comes upon a unique LBX – a complex, customizable, palm-sized robot. Use it – and team up with familiar characters from the hit TV series – to take down the evil corporation known as the New Dawn Raisers.

Mamegoma Happy! Sweets Farm.name: Mamegoma: Happy! Sweets Farm
Mamegoma Happy! Sweets Farm.summary: Simulation game developed by Racjin for the Nintendo 3DS. It features San-X, a miniature seal known for its adorable appearance. In this game, you assist the patissier Mamegoma in restoring peace disrupted by demons.

Senran Kagura 2 - Deep Crimson.name: Senran Kagura 2: Deep Crimson
Senran Kagura 2 - Deep Crimson.summary: Senran Kagura 2: Deep Crimson is a 3D side-scrolling action game made for the 3DS, and was developed by the same team which created Senran Kagura Burst. New gameplay is included in the form of pair battles, which allows a second character, to which the player can give commands, to fight alongside the player's character. The playable characters in the game are customizable. Outfits, accessory size and position, and hair color can be changed to the player's liking. Augmented reality functionality was also included in the game. The playable characters could be posed against a real-life background in a variety of poses.

Shin Sekaiju no Meikyuu - Millennium no.name: Etrian Odyssey Untold: The Millennium Girl
Shin Sekaiju no Meikyuu - Millennium no.summary:
Etrian Odyssey Untold: The Millennium Girl is the first in the Untold series which are to be remakes of the original Etrian Odyssey games. The games are first person RPG dungeon crawlers where you create a map of the labyrinth as you explore and complete quests.

The game features two game modes. The new story mode, has a pre-made party with a more in-depth story that has voice acting and animated cutscenes, and an enhanced classic mode, customize a party of 5 from 9 classes to explore the Yggdrasil labyrinth.

The game allows for the save data from story mode to be carried over to the classic mode once completed.

Shingeki no Kyojin - Jinrui Saigo no Tsu.name: Attack on Titan: Humanity in Chains
Shingeki no Kyojin - Jinrui Saigo no Tsu.summary: Based on the hit "Attack on Titan" anime and manga, players will defend the three Walls from invading Titans as a member of the elite Scout Regiment with their omni-directional mobility gear and blades. Based on the upcoming Japanese remake of an earlier Attack on Titan game, Humanity in Chains will be the first Attack on Titan game to reach North American shores, and will release exclusively on the Nintendo eShop for Nintendo 3DS in May 2015 with the original Japanese audio and English subtitles.

Wan Nyan Doubutsu Byouin - Pet no Oisha-.name: Wan Nyan Doubutsu Byouin: Pet no Oisha-san ni Narou!
Wan Nyan Doubutsu Byouin - Pet no Oisha-.summary:
Pet kept under various owners can simulate an important job of curing injuries and diseases, and while playing the game, you will foster animal! The stage is an animal hospital, you will take good care of various kinds of Wannyan at once! Appearing 30 kinds of sesame nihon!

A total of 20 types of Oshigoto games are included! In a hospital, as you do your job well, you will be able to leave more responsible roles. Rehabilitation to injury treatment, every day until your care, a wide range of work has become a game!

Holiday fun There are two days off every month. On this day, you can enjoy things other than work. In thetown there are shopping buildings, parks, movie theaters, etc. You can go out with hospital colleagues and my pets.

You can also enjoy coordinating fashion and interior! More than 700 kinds of fashion items are available for women & men! There are 24 kinds of hair styles you can choose!
